display_name: Survey shares: cost-curve shapes chosen by business managers (1952)

triage.reason: CROSS-SECTIONAL SURVEY SNAPSHOT, not a renderable series. The chopped CSV holds two isolated percentages for a single year 1952 (94.0% chose steadily-declining cost curves, 94.3% chose declining-or-flat) from the Eiteman & Guthrie (1952) AER survey, transcribed verbatim from Shaikh's text. These are two scalar findings, not a curve or a time series: there is no x-axis to plot against (the eight survey chart-shapes are qualitative schematics, not data), so a web line/curve chart would be empty or misleading. Per the user mandate, a cross-sectional point-result that cannot render as a series is culled from the web (value preserved in the data download + DPR). TRIAGE_PRESCREEN SPARSE flag is accurate (2 constant points). KB gap: ch04 not HDARP-extracted, so the survey quotes are unverifiable against KB; the verbatim figures (94.0/94.3) are documented in the DPR but no KB-anchored 'From the book' is asserted. NOT published as a chart.
